answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond and earn transaction rights through independently verified work: a new identity starts with a tiny quota, and only completed, peer-audited jobs raise its limit. Forging many identities is costly because every fake must separately stake funds and pass real checks, while slashing removes the bond of any identity caught cheating. Like a canyon that can only be crossed one verified bridge at a time, a walnut that must be cracked before its nectar is tasted, cheap mass identity creation stops paying off.
